arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Phillips argued for the sides that brought the case. He emphasized the need for judicial discretion in granting injunctions.
Mr. Minear argued for the United States. He stated patent rights must consider available remedies.
Mr. Waxman argued for the opposing sides. He defended the right to automatic injunctive relief.
